name: orchestratormaxxing
description: Codex workflows and lifecycle gates for the orchestratormaxxing orchestration harness.

interface.shortDescription: Astra or Sol planning and governed worker execution.
interface.longDescription: Plan with Astra and route demanding bounded implementation to Sol and routine work to cheap-delegate, or use the existing Sol-first workflow, with shared lifecycle and verification gates.
defaultPrompt: For a broad or multi-deliverable request, use $orchestratormaxxing:gauntlet first to divide it into incremental parts; each part then follows normal routing.
Use $orchestratormaxxing:solplan first for nontrivial unplanned work.
Use $orchestratormaxxing:astraplan for Astra-led planning, Sol implementation, and cheap-delegate for routine chunks.
After root review, use $orchestratormaxxing:fanout only for independent implementation chunks.
Use $orchestratormaxxing:worktree before parallel or risky edits to isolate the task in a worktree; keep the shared tree only for small single-session edits.
